items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: v2-look Accordion: theme background, padding, cursor, and hover/focus/press color styling on the unstyled @tamagui/ui Accordion Trigger and Content. The behavior keeps only the Collapsible trigger/content behavior.

items.name: alertdialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: v2-look AlertDialog: scrim background on the Overlay and background/border/padding/radius/elevation on the Content, over the unstyled @tamagui/ui AlertDialog behavior.

native: requires a Portal provider at the app root for the alert dialog to mount above content

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: v2-look Button: token-based sizing through the opt-in @tamagui/size policy, circular and variant (outlined/quiet) skins, icon + text composition on the unstyled @tamagui/ui Button behavior.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: v2-look Card: theme background over the unstyled @tamagui/ui Card behavior (structural layout + the size mechanism for size-derived radius and Header/Footer padding). Statics: Card.Header, Card.Footer, Card.Background.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: v2-look Checkbox: token-based sizing, theme background/border/focus styling, disabled dimming, and a centered indicator over the unstyled @tamagui/ui Checkbox behavior.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: v2-look Dialog: scrim background on the Overlay and background/border/padding/radius/elevation on the Content, over the unstyled @tamagui/ui Dialog behavior (which keeps only positioning + pointer-event bookkeeping).

native: requires a Portal provider at the app root for the dialog to mount above content

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: v2-look Input and TextArea: theme palette, border, background, body font, and hover/focus color styling on the unstyled @tamagui/ui Input/TextArea behavior (which keeps only structural sizing + the native outline reset).

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: v2-look Label: theme text color + press color feedback, over the unstyled @tamagui/ui Label behavior (label element, flex alignment, selection/cursor resets, the size-derived font mechanism, and the htmlFor/aria wiring).

items.name: listitem
items.title: ListItem
items.description: v2-look ListItem: theme palette, border, cursor, hover/press color styling, text color, the outlined/active appearance, and disabled dimming, over the unstyled @tamagui/ui ListItem behavior (which keeps structural layout + the size mechanism + the disabled pointer-event block).

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: v2-look Popover: token-based padding and radius with theme background and arrow border styling, over the unstyled @tamagui/ui Popover behavior.

native: requires a Portal provider at the app root for the popover to mount above content

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: v2-look Progress: theme background on the track and indicator + pill radius on the track, over the unstyled @tamagui/ui Progress behavior (clip, size-derived track height, and the indeterminate/complete/loading state machine). Static: Progress.Indicator.

items.name: radiogroup
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: v2-look RadioGroup: token-based item sizing, theme background/border/focus styling, disabled dimming, and a centered color indicator over the unstyled @tamagui/ui RadioGroup behavior.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: v2-look Select: styled trigger/value/icon, viewport with elevation, items with highlight + check indicator, scroll buttons and separators, over the unstyled @tamagui/ui Select behavior. Adapts to a Sheet on native.

native: requires a Portal/Adapt provider at the app root; on native the Select adapts to a Sheet, so the Sheet native peer requirements apply when adaptation is used

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: v2-look Separator: theme line color over the unstyled @tamagui/ui Separator behavior (orientation + layout + the collapsed 1px rule, transparent by default). Supports the vertical variant.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: v2-look Sheet: styled handle (open/closed opacity), dimmed overlay, rounded background, padded container and scroll view, plus the controlled composition, over the unstyled @tamagui/ui Sheet behavior.

native: requires a Portal provider at the app root for the sheet to mount above content
react-native-safe-area-context is used for safe-area insets on native (optional peer)

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: v2-look Slider: track color + radius, active-range fill color + radius, and thumb border/background/hover/press/focus color styling, over the unstyled @tamagui/ui Slider behavior (which keeps fill/clip/positioning + the thumb size mechanism).

items.name: surface
items.title: Surface
items.description: Surface: a copied panel/well/toolbar fixture with composable chrome and interaction facets plus a relative `level` theme boundary. Nothing is on by default; every facet is opt-in.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: v2-look Switch: token-based frame and thumb sizing with theme background and focus styling, over the unstyled @tamagui/ui Switch behavior.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: v2-look Tabs: token-based trigger sizing with theme background, hover/press/focus styling, and disabled dimming over the unstyled @tamagui/ui Tabs behavior.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: v2-look Toast (v2 composable API): card background/border/radius/padding/shadow/focus outline, styled title/description text, rounded close button, action/cancel buttons, and the styled default toast content wired through Toast.List renderItem, over the unstyled @tamagui/toast behavior (state engine, stacking, drag-to-dismiss, timers).

native: requires a Portal provider at the app root for the toast viewport to mount above content

items.name: togglegroup
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: v2-look ToggleGroup: theme palette, border, hover/press/focus color styling, and the default active (pressed-on) appearance on the unstyled @tamagui/ui ToggleGroup Item. The behavior keeps only structural layout + the size mechanism and emits aria-pressed/data-state.

items.name: facets
items.title: facets
items.description: Composable Surface facets: filled, outlined, elevated, rounded (chrome, static styles only) and interactive (hover/press/focus pseudos). Canonical boolean variants, pure functions of theme generics + conventional variables, spreadable into any styled() variants block. Nothing on by default.
